{{Quote|Sir, while I cannot thank the Imperial bureaucracy for the numerous delays and aborted postings suffered by Wetyin's Colony these seven years, I am confident the Yavin system will more than make up for the harassment.|Lile Gorsek|<ref name="GG2" />}}
'''Wetyin's Colony''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Wetyin's Colony system/Legends|Wetyin's Colony system]] of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A dry [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]], it was settled by colonists from [[Setor/Legends|Setor]] around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]] and was later largely abandoned.

==Description==
Wetyin's Colony was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of dry plains<ref name="TEA" /> located within the [[Wetyin's Colony system/Legends|Wetyin's Colony system]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated at the terminus of [[Wetyin's Way]], which connected it to [[Glade]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The inhabitants of Wetyin's Colony were originally from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Setor/Legends|Setor]].<ref name="GG2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> They moved to Wetyin's Colony around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], bringing [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] loaded with grain seed and [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] embryos, and were later virtually abandoned due to the shifting budgets of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] ministries.<ref name="TEA" /> The colonists continued searching for a new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. One [[Scout/Legends|scout]], [[Lile Gorsek]], investigated [[Betshish]] as a possible location; however, the discovery of a [[Unidentified Betshish species|native]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the planet voided his claim. A second location mooted by Gorsek was [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="GG2" /> At some point between [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] and [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around Wetyin's Colony was incorporated into the [[Zsinj's Empire|empire]] of [[Zsinj]], and it remained within the territory until Zsinj's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
